services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: From calm family outings to big-time catches, our guided charters deliver fun, fish, and fantastic views on the St. Lawrence River. Your trip includes everything you need to fish like a pro-except your fishing license, which you’ll need to bring along. Dress for the weather, pack sunscreen and snacks, and don’t forget your camera! Capt. John also offers classic shore dinners upon request. Just show up ready to fish, laugh, and create memories your family will talk about for years. Chartering with Capt. John at Slate’s Sure Thing Charters means more than just fishing-it’s a full experience. With expert knowledge of the best local fishing spots, top-quality gear, and a family-friendly

blurb: Guests fish the St. Lawrence River in the Thousand Islands region with Capt. John Slate, targeting species like Walleye, Smallmouth Bass, Northern Pike, and Muskies depending on the season. The experience is suitable for first-timers and seasoned anglers alike. The guide shares favorite fishing spots and stories during the trip.
